2.name: /recordready
2.col_2: USAGE:<hex:02100103>　/recordready [subcommand]<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>→Opens and closes the Duty Recorder interface.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>>>Subcommands:<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>[countdowntime]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Initiate a record ready check<hex:02100103>　　to begin recording a duty.<hex:02100103>　　When all party members<hex:02100103>　　consent to the recording,<hex:02100103>　　a countdown will start at<hex:02100103>　　the specified time.<hex:02100103>　　Subsequent uses of this<hex:02100103>　　command during the same<hex:02100103>　　duty will function as both a<hex:02100103>　　ready check and countdown.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Opens the Duty Recorder interface when no subcommand is specified.
2.translation_col_2: USO:<hex:02100103>　/recordready [sottocomando]<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>→Apre e chiude l'interfaccia del Registratore Duty.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>>>Sottocomandi:<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>[countdowntime]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Initiate a record ready check<hex:02100103>　　to begin recording a duty.<hex:02100103>　　When all party members<hex:02100103>　　consent to the recording,<hex:02100103>　　a countdown will start at<hex:02100103>　　the specified time.<hex:02100103>　　Subsequent uses of this<hex:02100103>　　command during the same<hex:02100103>　　duty will function as both a<hex:02100103>　　ready check and countdown.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Opens the Duty Recorder interface when no subcommand is specified.

9.name: /bluespellbook
9.col_2: USAGE:<hex:02100103>　/bluespellbook [subcommand]<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>→Open and register active actions in the Blue Magic Spellbook.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>>>Subcommands:<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>set "blue mage action" on<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Adds the specified blue<hex:02100103>　　mage action to the list<hex:02100103>　　of active actions in the<hex:02100103>　　current set.<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03> set "blue mage action" off<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Removes the specified blue<hex:02100103>　　mage action from the list of<hex:02100103>　　active actions in the current<hex:02100103>　　set.<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>preset [active set 1-5]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Load the specified set of<hex:02100103>　　active actions.<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>clear<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Remove all active actions<hex:02100103>　　from the current active<hex:02100103>　　action set.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Opens the Blue Magic Spellbook when no subcommand is specified.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>>>Examples:<hex:02100103>　/bluespellbook set “Water Cannon”<hex:02100103>　(Sets the blue mage action<hex:02100103>　Water Cannon as an active<hex:02100103>　action in the current set.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>　/bluespellbook preset 2<hex:02100103>　(Loads active set 2.)
9.translation_col_2: USO:<hex:02100103>　/bluespellbook [sottocomando]<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>→Open and register active actions in the Blue Magic Spellbook.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>>>Sottocomandi:<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>set "blue mage action" on<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Adds the specified blue<hex:02100103>　　mage action to the list<hex:02100103>　　of active actions in the<hex:02100103>　　current set.<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03> set "blue mage action" off<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Removes the specified blue<hex:02100103>　　mage action from the list of<hex:02100103>　　active actions in the current<hex:02100103>　　set.<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>preset [active set 1-5]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Load the specified set of<hex:02100103>　　active actions.<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>clear<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Remove all active actions<hex:02100103>　　from the current active<hex:02100103>　　action set.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Opens the Blue Magic Spellbook when no subcommand is specified.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>>>Esempi:<hex:02100103>　/bluespellbook set “Water Cannon”<hex:02100103>　(Sets the blue mage action<hex:02100103>　Water Cannon as an active<hex:02100103>　action in the current set.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>　/bluespellbook preset 2<hex:02100103>　(Loads active set 2.)

26.name: /dice
26.col_2: USAGE:<hex:02100103>　/dice [chat mode] [subcommand]<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>→Displays a random number between 0 and 999 in the specified chat channel. Displays in the current chat mode when no chat mode is specified.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>>>Chat Modes:<hex:02100103>　Party<hex:02100103>　　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>party<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>p<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　Alliance<hex:02100103>　　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>alliance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>al<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　Free Company<hex:02100103>　　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>freecompany<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>fc<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　PvP Team<hex:02100103>　　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>pvpteam<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>pt<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　Linkshell<hex:02100103>　　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>linkshell1-8<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>l1-8<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　Cross-world Linkshell<hex:02100103>　　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>cwlinkshell1-8<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, <hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>cwl1-8<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103><hex:02100103>>>Subcommands:<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>[upper limit]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Set an upper limit to display a random number between 1 and the specified number. 325.name: /pvphotbar
325.col_2: USAGE:<hex:02100103>　/pvphotbar [subcommand]<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>→Edit and configure hotbar settings. This command can only be used with the PvP hotbar.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>>>Subcommands<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>action "action name" [#1] [#2]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Set the specified PvP action to slot [#2] in hotbar page [#1]. If "current" is entered for [#1], then the action will be set in the page displayed in hotbar 1. If [#2] is omitted, the action will be set to the lowest-numbered slot available. If both [#1] and [#2] are omitted, the action will be set to the lowest-numbered slot available on the lowest-numbered hotbar available. This applies to all of the following subcommands.<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>general "general action name" [#1] [#2]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Set the specified general action to slot [#2] in hotbar [#1].<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>item "item name" [#1] [#2]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Set the specified item to slot [#2] in hotbar [#1].<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>emote "emote name" [#1] [#2]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Set the specified emote to slot [#2] in hotbar [#1].<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>companion "companion action name" [#1] [#2]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Set the specified companion action to slot [#2] in hotbar [#1].<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>pet "action name" [#1] [#2]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Set the specified pet action to slot [#2] in hotbar [#1].<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>minion "minion name" [#1] [#2]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Set the specified minion to slot [#2] in hotbar [#1].<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>mount "mount name" [#1] [#2]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Set the specified mount to slot [#2] in hotbar [#1].<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>enemysign "enemy sign name" [#1] [#2]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Set the specified enemy sign to slot [#2] in hotbar [#1].<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>waymark "waymark name" [#1] [#2]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Set the specified waymark to slot [#2] in hotbar [#1].<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>change [number]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Replace current hotbar with hotbar [number].  If "next" or "prev" is entered in [number], then you can scroll through the pages of hotbar 1.<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>copy [job 1] [#1] [job 2] [#2]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Copy the contents of [job 1] hotbar [#1] to the [job 2] hotbar [#2].<hex:02100103>　　The subcommand "current" can be used to specify your current job.<hex:02100103>　　The subcommand "share" can be used instead of a job to specify your shared hotbar.<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>display [number] on<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Display hotbar [number].<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>display [number] off<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Hide hotbar [number].<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>display [number]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Toggle on/off hotbar [number].<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>share [number] on<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Make hotbar [number] shared.<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>share [number] off<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Unshare hotbar [number] and assign it to your current job.<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>share [number]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Toggle between on/off.<hex:02100103>　<hex:024804F201FA03><hex:024904F201FB03>remove [#1] [#2]<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>　　Remove the action assigned to slot [#2] on hotbar [#1].<hex:02100103>　　Replace [#2] with "all" to remove all actions from hotbar [#1].<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>>>Examples:<hex:02100103>　/pvphotbar action "Purify" 1 1<hex:02100103>　(Places Purify in slot [#1]<hex:02100103>　on hotbar [#1].)<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>　/pvphotbar change 2<hex:02100103>　(Replaces PvP hotbar [#1]<hex:02100103>　with PvP hotbar [#2].)
